event: The party enters a deeper Floor 21 section where three Hollow Wardens wait.
The stone's frequency here reads older, more settled.
Tomás calls the variables: three-Warden cluster, one east branch, traps at seven and nine.
Vesper spots the first trap at ten meters and points without breaking stride.
Mid-fight, a Warden pushes toward the trap at section nine.
Dayo calls hold nine; the Warden stands in dead space while Solenne and Nadia hit it.
The cluster clears in eight minutes.
Dayo adapts to the low ceiling of the east branch without waiting for Tomás.
Eight more minutes, and the lone Warden collapses into the floor.
Vesper lays her palm on the Warden's broken joint for seven seconds, then the shoulder.
She says its load distribution is the same as the wall's: the same design logic.
Tomás records it; Nadia's hand rests on her dulcimer case.
Miriam says intentional; Vesper says the same builder, or the same documentation.
They mark the section nine trap, walk around it and go on.
They reach the rest node at section eleven; the floor reads forty-seven percent done.
Nadia sits with her dulcimer case unopened, thumb along its edge.
Miriam writes in her notebook's main text; Vesper studies the ceiling's joints.
Tomás sits with his notation surface and corrected map open, not yet writing.
Solenne finds the locked door at the floor's far east end, a seam in the wall.
It bears the six-Aspect Composite symbol, with the Section 11-30 cooldown active.
They used their Composite Activation on Floor 17, so they cannot open it.
Solenne says she can't open it.
Dayo asks about the Floor 30 boundary; Tomás says the section resets there.
Nine floors to the boundary; nobody says the calculation aloud.
A mid-forties woman with a physical notebook steps into the amber light.
Solenne's Conductor reads Dr. Petra Vasic carrying something long held.
Vasic says they're past the Composite lock; Solenne says they can't open it.
Vasic says she knows: they activated the Floor 17 Repository Node three floors ago.
Dayo asks how; Vasic says the System logs it, for anyone who knows how to look.
Vasic knows of Cartographer's Truth today and the Brightspirit question.
Tomás notes she said on Floor 11 she had questions; she's been answering them.
Vasic says she needs to tell them something.
She is a System Scholar, and part of a nameless group calling itself the Architects.
Miriam says before; Vasic confirms: they knew something was coming before the System.
Vasic lays an older folded document on the terminal shelf.
They knew the six-Aspect model and that the Tower was built expecting such a party.
Solenne holds all six signals: the party is receiving it.
Vesper asks if her people built the Tower; Vasic says no, they are researchers.
The builders had the same or older documentation; Solenne names the six frequencies.
Solenne says Cartographer's Truth went deeper than the floor map.
Vasic notes the first confirmed direct perception of the frequencies.
She says the Composite doors are invitations, built for a six-Aspect party.
The Summit outcome needs a six-Aspect Full Chord; Dayo asks what outcome.
Vasic doesn't know: the documents give only an untranslated symbol for it.
Tomás asks to see the paper and studies it a long time.
He says its margin script matches the Floor 15 notice board entry.
He tells Vasic the entry described them, with modern English marginalia.
Vasic writes thirty seconds: the Architects have forty-seven entries none can read.
Tomás says it described things that hadn't happened yet when he read it.
Vasic says three years of study, and she didn't know it would be this specific.
Dayo asks what she wants; Vasic says only to know what they find, recorded accurately.
She says the Architects aren't Apex: the Summit matters past this city.
Vasic calls the Floor 11 paper a gift and a test; they used it, and she knows.
Miriam asks if the builders were human; Vasic says they don't know.
Vasic leaves them the translated document and goes back into the corridor.
After a long quiet, Nadia says: the Summit.
Tomás cross-references the paper with his notation: a gift and a test.
Dayo says they will decide on the door with more information. Not tonight.
Solenne runs the Conductor on all six and on the far-east door: filed under later.
